summary: Iteration 25 - Bulk Reprocess + 90-day JWT + Web Push subscribe/unsubscribe/status + sw.js validated. All 15 backend tests pass; admin Bulk Reprocess UI + consumer login flow work end-to-end on the preview URL.

issues: Uses native browser date pickers (HTML <input type='date'>) rather than the shadcn Calendar component — acceptable for admin tooling but inconsistent with the rest of the design system.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 6727 lines — consider splitting bulk-reprocess + helpers into a dedicated routes/admin_bills.py module for maintainability.

Bulk reprocess date filter uses string-prefix comparison on created_at (ISO strings). Works but is fragile if created_at format ever changes; consider parsing to datetime and using $gte/$lte with real Date objects.

BulkReprocessRequest accepts arbitrary strings for from_date/to_date with no Pydantic validation — invalid input doesn't 500 (good) but silently filters nothing. Consider validating YYYY-MM-DD with a field_validator and returning 422.

push_unsubscribe ignores `keys` payload (only uses endpoint+user_id) — fine, but the PushSubscriptionRequest model requires the same shape for both endpoints; consider a leaner UnsubscribeRequest with only `endpoint`.

NotificationPrompt only renders when Notification.permission==='default' (correct), but there is no test hook to verify it mounts — consider exposing the notif-prompt testid via a debug query string for QA.
sw.js (54 lines) is fine; verify push payload schema is documented before backend starts sending pushes (Firebase VAPID work is deferred).
seed_data_creation: Push subscription docs created+cleaned up under endpoint='test-ep-iteration25-A' for the consumer test user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk Reprocess endpoint at POST /api/admin/bills/bulk-reprocess; dry_run returns {dry_run, candidates, bills[]}, real run returns {processed, summary{approved,rejected,kept_pending,skipped,manual_review}, total_points_credited, results[]}. Idempotent — re-running on same bills does not double-credit (verified). Consumer JWT TTL is 90 days (decoded exp claim matches within 2-day slack). Web Push endpoints under /api/consumer/push/{subscribe,unsubscribe,status} — subscribe upserts on endpoint (no duplicates). /sw.js served from frontend root, contains push + notificationclick handlers. Preview DB had 1 test bill in pending_review state used for dry-run preview verification.
